text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Joy wanting the process kept warm for websockets and websockets carrying live shipment positions are both true at once; one is a preference, the other describes what the sockets are for."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The repo being open source says nothing about what websockets are used for; both hold."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Joy building the shipment tracking module and websockets carrying live positions can both be true; the new claim does not change that state."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The MIT license and the websocket usage are independent facts about the project; both stand."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "How a route is defined and what websockets transport are separate facts; neither contradicts the other."}]}
